definitions.name: U3C.DIVS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D DIV FLOOR D MUL N EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Positive integer on the stack -> ascending Vector of its divisors.

definitions.name: U3C.RED
definitions.body: 'S' BIND 1 6 RANGE S [ 'E' BIND U2B.BRED ] FOLD
definitions.note: Bracket String -> its unmatched remainder after six passes of U2B.BRED (enough for up to twelve characters).

definitions.name: U3C.BAL
definitions.note: Bracket String -> TRUE when it reduces to the empty String, i.e. when it is balanced.

definitions.name: U3C.DELTAS
definitions.body: '[' '(' REPLACE ']' ')' REPLACE CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 C '(' EQ SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: Bracket String -> Vector with +1 for each opening bracket and -1 for each closing bracket, per character.

definitions.name: U3C.QTYREC
definitions.body: 'ORD' BIND ORD [ 'O' BIND O 'sku' GET ] MAP ORD [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record from each sku to its total qty, skus in order of first appearance.
